huro-lst-0229.history: Breakwater Camp and Beach, managed by Dick Detro, rented cottages on railroad land beside the east pier while the east-side beaches were a popular swimming and camping destination in the 1930s and 1940s. The camp closed in 1947 when the Wheeling and Lake Erie Railroad asked that the cabins be moved off company property to make room for an expansion. (Huron Historical Society.)
